categories.label: Backend
categories.description: Server logic, APIs, parsers, background services and integrations; excludes database or authentication work when those are the main task.

categories.label: Data
categories.description: Schemas, SQL, migrations, persistence and data integrity.

categories.label: Authentication
categories.description: Sign-in, sessions, OAuth, identity and access permissions; excludes broader security reviews.

categories.label: Interface
categories.description: Implementing interface behavior, components, forms, navigation and interaction wiring; excludes primarily visual styling.

categories.label: Visual design
categories.description: Appearance, CSS, layout, typography, color, illustrations, icons and visual mockups.

categories.label: Motion
categories.symbol: Easing curve in a rounded frame
categories.description: Animation, transitions, easing, gestures and movement behavior when these are the main deliverable.

categories.label: Testing
categories.description: Writing or running automated tests, acceptance checks and verification as the primary task; excludes incidental tests during implementation.

categories.label: Debugging
categories.description: Diagnosing an unexplained failure or reproducing a bug; prefer the specific domain when implementing an already understood fix.

categories.label: Research
categories.description: Finding documentation, facts, files, products or external information; excludes studying course material and deciding an implementation architecture.

categories.label: Planning
categories.description: Architecture, tradeoffs, specifications, task decomposition and discussing what to build; excludes calendars and to-do lists.

categories.label: Writing
categories.description: Writing or revising guides, explanations, emails, letters, reports and other new text as the deliverable.

categories.label: Build and setup
categories.description: Build tooling, dependencies, CI, packaging, deployment, installation and environment configuration.

categories.label: Performance
categories.description: Profiling and improving latency, memory, responsiveness, throughput or resource consumption.

categories.label: Security
categories.description: Vulnerability review, secrets, privacy, hardening and threat modeling; routine sign-in implementation belongs to authentication.

categories.label: Voice and audio
categories.description: Transcription, dictation, speech synthesis, audio capture and voice interaction as the main task.

categories.label: Studying
categories.description: Learning or revising course material: explaining concepts, working through exercises, exam preparation, quizzes and flashcards.

categories.label: Notes and minutes
categories.description: Meeting minutes, lab or session protocols, logs and journals, and summarizing or extracting key points from a given text.

categories.label: Organizing
categories.description: Structuring information: notes, files and folders, naming schemes, tags, archives and personal knowledge bases.

categories.label: Schedule and tasks
categories.description: Calendars, deadlines, to-do lists, routines and time management; excludes planning what to build.

categories.label: Math and numbers
categories.description: Calculations, math problems, statistics, units, formulas and spreadsheet or data analysis; excludes database work.

categories.label: Language
categories.symbol: Two speech bubbles, A and script
categories.description: Translating, proofreading, rephrasing and grammar of existing text, and learning languages; writing a new document is writing.

categories.label: Ideas
categories.description: Brainstorming, naming, creative writing and weighing options to reach a decision.

categories.label: Everyday life
categories.description: Everyday matters: forms and paperwork, money, travel, shopping, health and other personal decisions.

categories.label: General
categories.description: Mixed or ordinary conversation with no clear work category. Use only when no more specific category fits.
